notes.title: Ready for The Dance Hall? 💃🕺Demo release
notes.notes:
Hello Detective! 🕵️

We've had a breakthrough in the investigation!

https://i.imgur.com/ZC71459.gif
Will you be able to answer the key questions surrounding the death of the android and push the case toward the dance hall – a lavish club for the elite, hiding the rot and bitterness of this world around it? Humans and androids alike frequent this place, but now it stands almost empty. 👁️

https://i.imgur.com/MiqTYJx.gif
Can you uncover what really happened here? Who is the owner, and what role did they play in the recent events? And finally – will the seemingly simple case of a dead android in an alley spiral into something far larger, involving powerful forces and the urban legends lurking in the shadows? 🧩

https://i.imgur.com/yyHCFzq.gif

Thank you so much for playing our demo! 

Remember that you can submit feedback on our Discord and through the dedicated Playtest Feedback Form (it’s also available after completing the demo).

https://i.imgur.com/w04sgfK.png

If you have any questions or suggestions, we are at your disposal on Discord or the Steam forum.

Hope to see you next time...
